# raff_project_member (Resource)

Adds an existing account user (or API key) to a project with a project-scoped role. Account-level invitations should use raff_member instead.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Project UUID.
- `role_id` (String) Role UUID. Must be project-scoped.

### Optional

- `api_key_id` (String) API key UUID. Mutually exclusive with target_user_id.
- `status` (String) active or suspended.
- `target_user_id` (String) Existing account user UUID. Mutually exclusive with api_key_id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `email` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `role_name` (String)
